idea-plugin.name: SerialVersionUID Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Automatically generate `serialVersionUID` for classes implementing the `Serializable` interface, with quick access via shortcuts: Windows/Linux: `Alt+S`, Mac: `Command+N`.

自动为实现Serializable接口的类生成serialVersionUID，可以按快捷键快捷添加 Windows/Linux:Alt+s Mac:Command+N
